{{Otheruses|Shield}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Ray_shield.png|thumb|right|250px|A ray-shielded blast door on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]]]]
{{Quote|See this wavy light around my body? It's a ray shield. Blaster fire can't get in or out. Neat, huh?|[[Feylara Raed]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''ray shield''' was a common type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. It was designed to absorb blasts from energy weapons such as [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. Ray shields absorbed much of the impact of the weapon's strike, rocking the ship and scoring the underlying [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The energy requirements for ray shields was tremendous; as such, they were only raised when combat was expected. The ray shield permeated the [[Hull/Legends|hull]], sheathing the vessel in layers of energy. The shield could extend out from the hull by [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeters]] or a few [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]], and was so powerful that it was often fatal to anyone who came into contact with it.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History and usage==
{{Quote|The shaft is ray shielded, so you'll have to use proton torpedoes.|[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Fambaas-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A pair of [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]] with a Gungan [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] projector]]

Many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] contained ray shields as a defense against laser weapons. They absorbed lasers like a sponge, and they even deflected some. When a shield took too many hits, it burned out and needed to be recharged.

Ray shields varied in size according to what they were protecting. [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] such as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] had multiple arrays, and some wealthy [[Star system/Legends|systems]] even had planetary shields. [[Personal energy shield/Legends|Personal shields]] were on the other end of the spectrum: Jedi [[Kyle Katarn]] used one to protect himself during most of his battles, and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used personal ray shields when they were gladiators in [[the Big Game]].

The [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] used a ray shield to try to contain the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Jadus]].

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of the Great Grass Plains]] used energy shields for personal defense against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] used a ray shield to hold [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] hostage in an attempt to persuade her Master to open a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] for him.

[[File:Deflector_Shield_SWG_PotV.jpg|220px|thumb|The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used ray shields during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].]]
The [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used ray shields to keep captives inside its prison cells.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the recently rescued [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were captured by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in [[Hallway 328/Legends|Hallway 328]] of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] by a ray shield that trapped them in the middle of the hallway.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] was protected by a ray shield, since a particle shield would prevent it from venting; therefore, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] could penetrate it, a fact which was pivotal in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ANH" />
